name: design-system-seed
title: Design System Seed
description: Skill that connects a design system made on claude.ai to every Open Context part: installs design-tokens, maps the design's tokens onto the token contract, runs design-sync with its contrast checks and loads the result
proof: every command, flag, file, path, token and utility it names exists in design-tokens 2.0.0, its example config and the token contract; planted mistakes are reported
postMessage: Installed at .claude/skills/design-system-seed/SKILL.md. Give your agent your design system's export; the skill maps it onto the parts' design tokens.
